# PNEUMA — Gospel of Mary, Chapter 9
**Agent:** PNEUMA (Dynamic/Functional)
**Source:** P.Berol. 8502, Gospel of Mary, p. 14 (partial) | Coptic
**Chapter:** 9

---

[Pages 11-14 are mostly lost. Only the last portion of page 14 survives.]

**9:1** [...]"...and Desire challenged it: 'I didn't see you coming down, but now I see you going up. You're lying — you belong to me!'

**9:2** "The soul replied, 'I saw you, but you never saw me. You never recognized me. I wore you like a cloak — and you never knew I was there.'

**9:3** "After saying this, the soul departed in great joy."

---

*Translator's Note (PNEUMA):* "Wore you like a cloak" vividly renders the *stolē* image — the soul's time in the material world was like wearing Desire as an outer garment. The soul's departure in joy signals its liberation.
